Abstract Aim: To evaluate the cost effectiveness of carbetocin compared to oxytocin when used as prophylaxis against post-partum hemorrhage (PPH) during cesarean deliveries.

dose.text: The analysis was conducted using a decision tree that rolled back the expected value of patients who received either intravenous carbetocin 100 mcg or oxytocin 5 IU (Fig. 1).
